study_design: Ecological analysis of food-group availability and country-level age-standardised cancer incidence rates in 18 African countries.
reason: The abstract evaluates age-standardised prostate cancer incidence rates at the ecological level but does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Ecological correlations adjusted for human development index, smoking and obesity rates were calculated to evaluate the relationship between food availability and ASR of breast, prostate, colorectal, oesophageal, pancreatic, stomach and thyroid cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol row belongs to an ecological analysis of overall prostate cancer incidence rates. No aggressive prostate cancer stratification is established, and the abstract does not provide an alcohol–prostate numeric estimate with a 95% CI.
